Item.Description: Clobber. Transfer file overwriting any existing file. Filename preserved.
Unique, check, keep filename. Check for the presence of an existing file, and if one exists proceed as UNK. If none, transfer with original filename.
Unique, check, new filename. Check for the presence of an existing file, and if one exists proceed as UNN. If none, transfer with original filename.
Unique, no check, keep filename. Do not check for the presence of an existing file, upload with a unique filename that keeps the original filename (e.g. OriginalFileName_UniqueSuffix.xml)
Unique, no check, new filename. Do not check for the presence of an existing file, upload with a unique filename generated by the server (e.g. UniqueName.xml)
Fail if exists. If the target filename already exists, do not transfer, but delete/move/etc the source file as per the archive option (so as not to keep touching it)
